reuse.why: Ignores the exported getScheduledAmount and the shared getApproxNumberThreshold, writing the range rule inline in two places and the approximate tolerance by hand as `* 0.075`.

duplication.why: The expected-amount rule now exists in scheduleModel.toExternal, in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and still in the untouched midpoint copies in forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (x2), schedule-template.ts and getScheduledAmount itself, each with a different rule.

placement.why: Amount planning logic is put into the API model mapper and the preview function instead of the shared scheduled-amount definition in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Touches the API type and model plus the preview, but leaves the other places that apply the rule unchanged, so the edits are both partial and scattered.

maintainability.why: Several divergent definitions of 'expected amount' (furthest-from-zero in the API, lowest value in previews, midpoint elsewhere) and a hard-coded tolerance make any later rule change error-prone.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal and shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions compute the amount inline instead of calling getScheduledAmount; the approximate tolerance bypasses shared/rules.ts getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: The approximate tolerance in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions re-expresses getApproxNumberThreshold as `Math.sign(x) * Math.round(Math.abs(x) * 0.075)`, and the API model reshapes the range rule as a nested Math.abs ternary rather than sharing getScheduledAmount.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount is never extended; api-models.ts toExternal and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions re-implement the rule, and forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, and schedule-template.ts keep their own midpoint copies.
